paite: TOUPA a ding in bukna diklou kihhuai ahi, himahleh gikdan dik akipahpih lam ahi.
Kisaktheihna ahong pai chiang in, zumna ahong pai; himahleh mikiniamkhiakte kiang ah pilna a-om hi.
Mitangte dikna in amau api ding, himahleh milepchiahte hoihlouhna in amau ahihse ding hi.
Thangpaih ni in hauhsak aphatuam kei, himahleh diktatna in sihna a kipan ahunkhia hi.
Mihoihkim diktatna in alampi aseksak dia; himahleh migilou agitlouhna ah apuk ding hi.
Mitangte diktatna in amau asuaktasak; himahleh lepchiahtak a hihte amau poikhoihna a lak in a-om ding uhi.
Migilou asih chiang in alametna amangthang ding; huan thulimlouhna lametna amangthang hi.
Midiktat buaina lak a kipan suahtaksak in a-om a, amun ah migilou ahong pai hi.
Akam a Pathian limsak lou mi'n a-inveng ahihsia a; himahleh theihna ziak in midiktat suahtaksak in a-om hi.
Midiktat alamzan chiang in, khopi akipak a; gilou amanthat chiang in, kikouna a-om hi.
Mitang vualzawlna ziak in khopi tawisang in a-om; himahleh migilou kam a hihsiat in a-om hi.
Kuapeuh a-inveng musit pilna bei ahi; himahleh theisiammi adai dide hi.
Tangthu genmi bang a vialvak in thuguk ataklang; himahleh lungsim muanhuai in thu a-im hi.
Kipina pil omlouhna mun ah mite apuk ua; himahleh thupha gen tampi omna ah bitna a-om hi.
Kuapeuh mikhual a dia amoh khu dia dingh in na asa ding, himahleh moh khu dia dinna hua amuang hi.
Numei deihhuai in zahtakhuaina anei gige; huan pasal hatte'n hauhsakna anei gige hi.
Michingthei in amah kha a ding in ahihhoih a; himahleh migilou in ama sa ahihbuai hi.
Migilou in loh gina sang lou a; himahleh diktatna tuh in kipahman muan anei hi.
Kuapeuh diktatna a dingkip in hinna atungding; huan kuapeuh gilou delh in ama sihna ding in ahih ahi.
Alungtang ua hoihloute TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi ua; himahleh alampi ua hoihkimte akipahna ahi.
Khut kilen mah le uh, migilou gawt louh in a-om kei ding; himahleh diktat chi suahtaksak in a-om ding hi.
Vok nak sung a dangka-eng suang bang in, huchibang in numei melhoih ngentelna nei lou ahi.
Midiktat deihlam hoih kia ahi a; himahleh migilou lametna thangpaihna ahi.
Athehzak a-om a, apung semsem hi; akilawm kheng a it a-om a, himahleh taksap lam amanoh lel hi.
Misiam thausak in a-om ding, huan kuapeuh tuibuak amah leng tui buah in a-om ding hi.
Kuapeuh buh-le-bal it, mite'n amah ahamsiat ding uh; himahleh kuapeuh azuaktu luzang ah vualzawlna a-om ding hi.
Kuapeuh hoih thanuamtak a zong in deihsakna azong; himahleh kuapeuh siatna zong, amah tung ah ahong tung ding hi.
Kuapeuh ahauhsakna muang apuk ding; himahleh nah hing bang in midiktat alun ding hi.
Kuapeuh ama inn hihbuai in huih aluah ding; huan mihai lungtang pil sikha in a-om ding hi.
Midiktat gah hinna sing ahi; kuapeuh apil in khate aman hi.
Ngai in, midiktatte lei ah thuk in a-om ding. Migilou leh mikhial kinak thuksem na'n chia!
